. The petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for following reliefs :
"(A) The Hon'ble Court may please to issue writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ in like nature, directing the respondent authorities to consider the claim dated 11.11.2024 of the petitioner filed under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, within stipulated period with further directions to pay the compensation amount as early as possible, if the petitioner found entitled for the 2 932_WP_1189_2026 compensation."
2 The petitioner's representation pertaining to his claim under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act is pending with respondent authorities for decision.
Learned AGP appearing for respondent Nos.1 and 2 states that notices have been issued and hearing is scheduled on 10.02.2026.

After the Chatrubhuj Rajaram Pawar vs The State Of Maharashtra And Others on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47319333/
